audience.text: Python developers building 3D content pipelines, especially in 3D printing, CAD, and visualization workflows requiring OBJ, STL, glTF, COLLADA, and 3MF support.

capabilities.text: Imports OBJ, STL, glTF/GLB, COLLADA, and 3MF files using Scene.open() with automatic format detection.
capabilities.title: Load multiple 3D formats

capabilities.text: Writes scenes to OBJ, STL, glTF/GLB, and 3MF using Scene.save() with format-specific SaveOptions.
capabilities.title: Export to common 3D formats

capabilities.text: Build hierarchical scenes using Scene, Node, and Transform objects with create_child_node() and child_nodes.
capabilities.title: Construct and manipulate scene graphs

capabilities.text: Define meshes via control points and polygons, or convert primitives using to_mesh() and PolygonBuilder.
capabilities.title: Create and edit mesh geometry

capabilities.text: Attach LambertMaterial, PhongMaterial, or PbrMaterial to nodes with configurable color and factor properties.
capabilities.title: Assign materials to nodes

capabilities.text: Create animation clips using AnimationClip, AnimationNode, and KeyframeSequence classes.
capabilities.title: Build keyframe animations

limitations.text: FBX export is not implemented; FbxExporter.save() and save_to_stream() raise NotImplementedError.
COLLADA export is not reachable through Scene.save() due to exporter lookup order issues.
Scene.render() and the entire aspose.threed.render module raise NotImplementedError.
Texture construction raises NotImplementedError; image-backed textures cannot be created.
Mesh boolean operations (union, difference, intersect) raise NotImplementedError.
NURBS curve evaluation and surface-to-mesh conversion raise NotImplementedError.

problems_solved.text: Enables pure-Python 3D scene processing without requiring native SDKs or external binaries.
Supports common 3D file formats used in additive manufacturing and 3D modeling workflows.
Provides programmatic scene graph construction and manipulation via Scene, Node, and Mesh objects.

product_summary.text: Aspose.3D FOSS for Python is a pure-Python, MIT-licensed library for loading, constructing, and exporting 3D scenes without native dependencies.

uncertainties: Whether the experimental FBX importer handles binary FBX files beyond ASCII.
Whether COLLADA import supports all features of the COLLADA 1.4/1.5 specifications.
Whether the triangulation implementation handles degenerate or self-intersecting polygons.
Whether PbrMaterial properties interact correctly with glTF PBR extensions during export.
Whether the package supports Python 3.13 or later beyond the listed versions.
Whether the package supports ARM64 or other non-x86 platforms beyond listed OSes.
Whether the package handles large scenes efficiently without memory issues.
Whether the package supports multi-threaded scene processing safely.

workflows.name: Import and inspect a 3D model
workflows.text: Open a 3D file using Scene.open() and traverse its node hierarchy to inspect geometry and structure.

workflows.name: Export a scene to glTF
workflows.text: Build a scene with primitives or meshes, assign materials, and save to glTF format using GltfSaveOptions.

workflows.name: Export a scene to STL
workflows.text: Construct a mesh from control points, attach it to a node, and export to ASCII STL using StlSaveOptions.

workflows.name: Export a scene to 3MF
workflows.text: Build a cube mesh programmatically, assign it to a node, and save to 3MF using ThreeMfSaveOptions.

workflows.name: Convert primitives to editable meshes
workflows.text: Instantiate parameterized primitives like Box or Sphere and convert them to Mesh via to_mesh().

workflows.name: Triangulate polygonal geometry
workflows.text: Triangulate arbitrary polygons using PolygonModifier.triangulate() to produce triangle fans.
